name: Kbd
description: A keyboard key or shortcut, as kbd elements. keys renders a combination in the platform's spelling: mod is ⌘ on macOS and iOS and Ctrl elsewhere, and the other modifiers follow (⌥ / Alt, ⇧ / Shift). Symbol keys carry their name as hidden text. Without keys, the content is one key.

livewire.name: kbd
capabilities: The server renders the other platforms' keys; a small Alpine component swaps in ⌘, ⌥ and ⇧ on Apple platforms when platform is auto
2.x content still works: <x-artisanpack-kbd>K</x-artisanpack-kbd> is one key

react.name: Kbd
capabilities: children is one key when keys is empty
The first render (and the server's) uses the other platforms' keys; Apple keys show after mount

vue.name: Kbd
capabilities: The default slot is one key when keys is empty
The first render (and the server's) uses the other platforms' keys; Apple keys show after mount

props.name: keys
props.description: The keys of a shortcut, in order, such as ['mod', 'shift', 'p']. Named keys: mod, cmd, ctrl, alt (option), shift, enter, esc, tab, space, backspace, delete and the arrows (up, down, left, right). A single character is uppercased; anything else (F5, PgUp) shows as given. Renders a combo, even for one key.

props.name: size
props.description: md for running text, sm inside menus, tooltips and other dense rows. Emitted as data-size on every key.

props.name: platform
props.description: Whose keys to show. auto checks the browser after it loads; mac and other fix it, such as when the server knows the platform.

props.name: labels
props.description: The hidden names of symbol keys, by name: command, control, option, shift, enter, tab, escape, backspace, up, down, left and right. Translate them: Livewire defaults each through __( 'Command' ) and the rest.
props.a11y: A symbol such as ⌘ reads as its name instead.

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part, such as { combo: '…', key: '…' }.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The first key cap, or the only one.

parts.name: combo
parts.description: The outer kbd around a shortcut's keys (`.apui-kbd-combo`), as HTML nests kbd for combinations. Keeps its order in RTL.

parts.name: key
parts.description: A key cap (`.apui-kbd`), with data-size. A symbol shows hidden from assistive technology, followed by its name as hidden text.

slots.name: default
slots.description: One key, when keys is empty.

requirements: Every key is a kbd element; a shortcut is a kbd of kbd elements.
Symbols (⌘, ⌥, ⇧, ⌃, ↵, arrows) have a text alternative read instead of the symbol.
The keys match the platform: ⌘ on Apple platforms, Ctrl elsewhere.
Not a control: never use Kbd as a button.
